doc: The 'schedules' group of host calls (cleat#3827). Each call is listed here as unbound ('pending: ...') until its binding lands; the PR that binds a call moves its entry from 'unbound' to 'bound' in THIS file and touches no other inventory file. See packages/cleat-ts/groups/README.md.

unbound.cleat_schedule_cron: pending: a cron schedule a workflow creates at run time.
unbound.cleat_delete_cron: pending: remove a cron schedule by id.
unbound.cleat_list_crons: pending: read the cron schedules the tenant has.
